headline: Borsa Istanbul Benchmark BIST 100 Closes 0.67% Lower
summary: Türkiye's BIST 100 index finished Thursday's trading session down 0.67% at 11,400.09 points, while the US dollar touched 50.47 lira.
why: The BIST 100 is the main benchmark equity index of Borsa Istanbul, tracking the top listed Turkish corporations.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: Broad selling lowered the BIST 100 index by 0.67% at the session close.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Domestic market selling and currency pressures dragged down the benchmark index.
